title: GST 111 (UNIZIK): CHAPTER 1 — Vowels and Consonants (Fricatives and Palatoalveolars)
subject: GST 111

questions.question: How many vowel sounds are there in English?
questions.explanation: English has 20 vowel sounds, made up of 12 pure vowels and 8 diphthongs.

questions.question: How many pure vowels (monophthongs) are there in English?
questions.explanation: English has 12 pure vowels, also called monophthongs.

questions.question: How many diphthongs are there in English?
questions.explanation: English has 8 diphthongs, which involve a glide from one vowel to another.

questions.question: All vowel sounds in English are:
questions.explanation: All English vowel sounds are voiced because the vocal cords vibrate during their production.

questions.question: Pure vowels are subdivided into:
questions.explanation: Pure vowels are divided into short vowels and long vowels.

questions.question: How many short vowels are there in English?
questions.explanation: English has 7 short vowels.

questions.question: How many long vowels are there in English?
questions.explanation: English has 5 long vowels.

questions.question: Which of the following is a long vowel?
questions.explanation: /i:/ is a long vowel, while the others are short vowels.

questions.question: Which of the following is a short vowel?
questions.explanation: /ʊ/ is a short vowel, while the others are long vowels.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "sit", "women", "city", "pity"?
questions.explanation: The words sit, women, city, and pity contain the short vowel /i/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "peak", "feel", "seat", "team"?
questions.explanation: The words peak, feel, seat, and team contain the long vowel /i:/.

questions.question: The vowel /e/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Sit contains /i/, not /e/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "man", "fat", "black", "cap"?
questions.explanation: The words man, fat, black, and cap contain the vowel /æ/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "far", "arm", "fast", "heart"?
questions.explanation: The words far, arm, fast, and heart contain the long vowel /a:/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "pot", "want", "hop", "hot"?
questions.explanation: The words pot, want, hop, and hot contain the short vowel /ɒ/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "lord", "cork", "port", "sword"?
questions.explanation: The words lord, cork, port, and sword contain the long vowel /ɔ:/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "foot", "good", "bull", "look"?
questions.explanation: The words foot, good, bull, and look contain the short vowel /ʊ/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "fool", "pool", "shoe", "soup"?
questions.explanation: The words fool, pool, shoe, and soup contain the long vowel /u:/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "come", "oven", "money", "cup"?
questions.explanation: The words come, oven, money, and cup contain the vowel /ʌ/.

questions.question: Which vowel is found in "mercy", "her", "serve", "girl"?
questions.explanation: The words mercy, her, serve, and girl contain the long vowel /ɜ:/.

questions.question: The schwa sound /ə/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Bed contains /e/, not the schwa sound /ə/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "day", "face", "way", "rain"?
questions.explanation: The words day, face, way, and rain contain the diphthong /ei/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "go", "low", "soul", "home"?
questions.explanation: The words go, low, soul, and home contain the diphthong /əu/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "eye", "island", "kite", "time"?
questions.explanation: The words eye, island, kite, and time contain the diphthong /ai/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "cow", "how", "loud", "house"?
questions.explanation: The words cow, how, loud, and house contain the diphthong /au/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "boy", "toy", "oil", "choice"?
questions.explanation: The words boy, toy, oil, and choice contain the diphthong /ɔi/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "hear", "beer", "fear", "cheer"?
questions.explanation: The words hear, beer, fear, and cheer contain the diphthong /iə/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "heir", "care", "share", "chair"?
questions.explanation: The words heir, care, share, and chair contain the diphthong /eə/.

questions.question: Which diphthong is found in "poor", "tour", "pure", "cure"?
questions.explanation: The words poor, tour, pure, and cure contain the diphthong /uə/.

questions.question: A triphthong has a sequence of how many vowels?
questions.explanation: A triphthong is a sequence of three vowel sounds.

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of a triphthong?
questions.explanation: /aia/ is a triphthong because it consists of three vowel sounds.

questions.question: The word "tyre" contains which triphthong?
questions.explanation: Tyre contains the triphthong /aia/.

questions.question: The word "power" contains which triphthong?
questions.explanation: Power contains the triphthong /aua/.

questions.question: Which of the following words contains the vowel /æ/?
questions.explanation: Man contains the vowel /æ/.

questions.question: Which of the following words contains the vowel /ʌ/?
questions.explanation: Cup contains the vowel /ʌ/.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a fricative?
questions.explanation: /t/ is a plosive, not a fricative.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiceless labiodental fricative?
questions.explanation: /f/ is a voiceless labiodental fricative.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiced labiodental fricative?
questions.explanation: /v/ is a voiced labiodental fricative.

questions.question: The sound /θ/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: This contains /ð/, not /θ/.

questions.question: The sound /ð/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Thank contains /θ/, not /ð/.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiceless alveolar fricative?
questions.explanation: /s/ is a voiceless alveolar fricative.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiced alveolar fricative?
questions.explanation: /z/ is a voiced alveolar fricative.

questions.question: The sound /ʃ/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Vision contains /ʒ/, not /ʃ/.

questions.question: The sound /ʒ/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Sheep contains /ʃ/, not /ʒ/.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiceless palate-alveolar affricate?
questions.explanation: /tʃ/ is a voiceless palate-alveolar affricate.

questions.question: Which of the following is a voiced palate-alveolar affricate?
questions.explanation: /dʒ/ is a voiced palate-alveolar affricate.

questions.question: The sound /tʃ/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Judge contains /dʒ/, not /tʃ/.

questions.question: The sound /dʒ/ is found in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: Cheese contains /tʃ/, not /dʒ/.

questions.question: The sound /h/ is silent in all EXCEPT:
questions.explanation: House has a pronounced /h/, while honour, hour, and honest have a silent h.

questions.question: Which of the following words contains a palato-alveolar fricative?
questions.explanation: Ship contains the palato-alveolar fricative /ʃ/.
